exposure: Regular or NPH human insulin (if diet alone insufficient)
outcome: Glycaemic control (fasting glucose <95mg/dl, 2 hour postprandial glucose <120mg/dl)
cohort: The study included 70 uncomplicated Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) patients who received an intervention and 35 healthy pregnant controls.
finding: A simple, safe, and cost-effective GDM management strategy, including MNT, once weekly SMBG, and insulin if needed, can be effectively implemented in resource-limited settings, leading to excellent maternal and neonatal outcomes with no reported cases of macrosomia, perinatal death, birth injury, congenital malformations, or shoulder dystocia.
